messages:
alex.security: Heads up — after the IdP SAML cert rotation at 03:05 UTC we're seeing SCIM sync backlog + a bunch of KMS decrypt errors on the provisioning workers. Noting user deprovisions flap. Anyone already triaging?

maria-iam: saw the alert. SCIM queue depth jumped ~8k, error rate ~12% for scim.apply jobs. Logs show: `error=KMS.DecryptFailed: decryption context mismatch` for tokens generated before rotation.

sam-sre: adding context: we rotated the SAML cert *and* rotated the SCIM service principal secret yesterday. Possible race where some provisioning tokens were re-encrypted with new key/context but workers in other AZ still have old cached envelope keys.

jenna-devex: deploying a hotfix to the SCIM workers to fallback to re-encrypt path: `aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct --destination-key-id alias/redwood-scim` — planning canary to 2 workers.

alex.security: good. can we confirm this isn't an attacker replaying tokens? tim-privacy, any red flags in the audit logs?

 tim-privacy: quick grep of audit: `scim.requester=okta-app-123 action=provision status=403 reason=KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` — timestamps line up with rotation window. No unusual IPs. Looks internal.

okta-bot: Automated note: IdP cert rotation completed successfully at 03:02 UTC. Provisioning webhook deliveries retried by Okta.

sam-sre: mitigation idea: 1) pause SCIM consumer workers, 2) flush and persist queue to S3 as backup, 3) run re-encrypt job against backlog, 4) resume worker pool gradually.

maria-iam: agree. Also need to patch RBAC check that currently rejects re-encrypt jobs if the service principal only has decrypt but not re-encrypt on the old key. We should avoid needing manual key swaps.

jenna-devex: rolling patch pushed to canary (2 instances). It catches KMS.DecryptFailed and calls re-encrypt using service-account credentials, with exponential backoff. Logs: `re-encrypt attempted for msg_id=... status=ok` for 42/100 so far.

alex.security: nice. please add a safety switch to stop re-encrypt if any integrity mismatch (user mismatch) is detected. we don't want to accidentally re-provision wrong user.

jenna-devex: already added: we compare `scim.externalId` + `requester_id` in decrypted payload against existing record before applying. aborts if mismatch.

sam-sre: FYI after pausing workers and re-encrypting ~3k items, sync lag dropped from 8k->900. resuming at 10% capacity for smoke tests.

maria-iam: postmortem action items: document key rollout playbook, require re-encrypt permission for service principals, and add a canary rollout for IdP certs (drain queue, rotate cert in a single control-plane leader).

alex.security: +1. also add alert for `SCIM queue > 2000 && KMS.DecryptFailed > 5%` so we catch earlier.

 tim-privacy: I'm going to open an audit ticket for review of any impacted entitlements. We should run a quick scan to ensure no one lost access unexpectedly.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: scim-worker-frontend v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4 (canary). Observability: new metric `scim.reencrypt.attempts` emitted.

jenna-devex: can confirm smoke user provisioning succeeded via Okta UI and API. Monitoring turning green. will follow up with full run and write-up in postmortems. :thumbsup:

alex.security: Thanks all — if anything odd after full resume tag me. We'll capture the timeline in incidents later.
